text:
The Blackhawks held a players' meeting after this one, and you can see why. Carolina scored four times in the first period, three more in the second, and two late in the third for a 9-2 win in Raleigh that kept the Hurricanes atop the NHL standings before they head to Finland. Chicago is now winless in six (0-5-1).

It was over early. Seth Jarvis scored 1:34 in, Jackson Blake backhanded in a second at 3:21, and Jordan Martinook added two before the first intermission, the second with 33 seconds left. By then our win probability model had Carolina past 90 percent, and the shots were telling the same story: the Hurricanes out-chanced Chicago 1.60 to 0.50 in expected goals (the quality of chances) in the first and 1.08 to 0.13 in the second. Andrei Svechnikov, Sebastian Aho and Alexander Nikishin scored in the middle period, Nikishin on a slap shot that goes in about 3 percent of the time.

Spencer Knight had a night he'll want to forget: six goals on 17 shots, 3.7 more than those shots deserved. Arvid Soderblom took over and allowed three on 16. Not all of it was on them. The Hurricanes deserved to win 81 percent of the time by our numbers, out-attempted Chicago 58 to 41, and every goal came at even strength. Carolina spent zero minutes in the penalty box. Aho finished with a goal and two assists; the Martinook, Jesperi Kotkaniemi and Eric Robinson line produced two goals of its own.

The Blackhawks' only good stretch came when the game was gone. Roman Kantserov, the league's leading rookie goal scorer, finished a Connor Bedard pass early in the third, and Bedard scored himself at 13:41. Chicago matched Carolina's 1.69 expected goals in the third, which is something, but not much.

The bigger picture in Chicago is uncomfortable. Patrick Kane is out hurt, coach Jeff Blashill is under growing pressure in the headlines, and Wyatt Kaiser told The Athletic's Mark Lazerus that the meeting was about ideas on how "to get out of this." Carolina, meanwhile, looks like a team that could play anyone, anywhere, including Finland.
headline: Hurricanes run over Chicago before the trip to Finland
